symptom: `ALTER SETTINGS CONFIGURATION 'Default' ExtraJvmParameters = '-Dhttps.proxyHost=127.0.0.1 -Dhttps.proxyPort=29758'` → `Error: unknown configuration setting: ExtraJvmParameters` (create configuration: `unknown configuration property`), and `describe settings` never printed the field, so a described project replayed without it
cause: Only the executor's two hand-copied configuration key switches (alterSettingsConfiguration, createConfiguration) lacked the case. The reader already filled model.ServerConfiguration.ExtraJvmParameters (settings_read.go) and the overlay already wrote it back (settingsoverlay.ServerConfiguration) — on every settings write, so the value was preserved, just unreachable from MDL
insight: For an 'unknown setting' report, check the three layers before designing anything: reader (settings_read.go), writer (settingsoverlay), executor switch. Here two of three were done and the fix was one case per switch plus a describe line. Version facts settled by the Model SDK (npm pack mendixmodelsdk, gen/settings.js): Configuration.extraJvmParameters has no versionInfo entry, so no gate; a Studio Pro-authored 11.14 configuration stores `ExtraJvmParameters` (string) beside `MaxJavaHeapSize`. Wrong turn to skip: replaying the regression with `create or modify configuration 'NewName'` on testdata/testapp-views (11.14) fails with "3 element id(s) are used more than once" — a separate, pre-existing bug (newServerConfiguration shallow-copies a sibling whose nested OpenTelemetry part keeps its $IDs; works on 11.13/11.6 fixtures), not this fix. `mxcli run --local` builds a fixed JVM argument list and does not apply the parameters — the model value is what Studio Pro uses
